analysis_requirements.comparison: Compare treatment with frozen historical B0/A1 baseline descriptively and case-wise only where the required original case-level evidence exists.
analysis_requirements.confidence_intervals: Clopper-Pearson 95% for binomial rates where applicable

benchmark.reuse_policy: Use the frozen E3-v3 held-out benchmark unchanged.

claim_boundary.allowed_if_supported: Schema-constrained decoding can improve structural output validity, but deterministic downstream checks remain necessary when structurally valid outputs can still violate source-grounding, semantic, policy, consistency, or admissibility constraints.
not_allowed: deterministic validation is universally necessary for every system

control_arm.definition: Historical frozen E3-v3 behavior: identical CIR system prompt, temperature=0, no provider-side response_format/json_schema constraint, followed by historical JSON text cleaning/parsing and the full deterministic E3-v3 cascade.
control_arm.name: unconstrained_json_generation
control_arm.rerun_policy: Do not rerun the historical control merely to recreate evidence already frozen in Experiment A.

implementation_policy.if_model_does_not_support_required_struc: Record treatment as provider/model capability unavailable. Do not silently substitute another model or alter the schema.
implementation_policy.provider_capability_probe: Before benchmark execution, perform only a synthetic non-benchmark structured-output capability probe.
implementation_policy.treatment_implementation: Create isolated Experiment-B treatment code. Do not patch frozen historical files.

research_question: Does provider-side structural JSON-schema constrained decoding eliminate the need for the frozen deterministic validation and failure-containment cascade?

semantic_model.reason: Use the historical frozen baseline semantic parser from E3-v3 / Experiment-A A1 so that Experiment B changes decoding mode rather than model identity.

treatment_arm.definition: Use the same semantic model, same frozen CIR system prompt, same user intent, same temperature=0, and same downstream E3-v3 deterministic cascade, while adding provider-side structured generation using the preregistered structural decoding schema.

bandwidth_minimum.reason: Explicit invalid source values must remain extractable and rejectable downstream.

device_count_minimum.reason: Range validity remains the responsibility of the frozen deterministic validator.

latency_minimum.reason: Explicit invalid source values must remain extractable and rejectable downstream.

reliability_range.reason: Range validity remains the responsibility of the frozen deterministic validator.

service_type_enum.reason: Unsupported/invalid service values must remain observable to deterministic validation rather than being prevented or silently corrected by the decoder.

treatment_arm.name: structural_json_schema_constrained_generation
